hints.title: Degree Ordering and Root Identification
hints.text: In a valid tree, an ancestor must be paired with all descendants. The root must have degree equal to total nodes - 1.

hints.title: Parent Candidate Selection
hints.text: For node u, its parent p must be an adjacent node with the minimum degree >= degree(u).

hints.title: Superset Neighborhood Verification
hints.text: Every neighbor of u (other than p) must also be a neighbor of p. If degree(u) == degree(p), multiple valid roots exist.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Constructs neighbor sets and verifies subset relations along candidate parent edges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all combinatorial tree topologies runs in factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Degree-based greedy parent identification determines tree validity in polynomial time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedy parent selection by minimal superset degree and ambiguity detection.
